old_problem: A generic chosen drive is unsafe because Linux device paths are mutable and may identify OS, boot, EFI, swap, mounted production, LVM, RAID or shared storage. The destructive target, workload, thresholds, monitoring and re-provision recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row clearly requires SSD stress through NVQual Test #18. ED-04 permits a parameterized destructive storage testcase only with stable target identity, protected-storage exclusions and explicit data-loss authorization. Target, job and thresholds remain Project Configuration and keep the execution gate closed, but do not require a new review decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2137, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2138 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00015-V002 / 66ce5e60eac806a6 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind a disposable owner-approved target by serial/WWN/namespace plus partition/filesystem/mount/LVM/RAID/device-mapper ancestry; device path alone is never sufficient.
Prove and revalidate immediately before launch that the target is not OS, boot, EFI, swap, mounted production, LVM/RAID metadata, shared or unknown storage; any mapping change closes the gate.
Pin the exact Test #18/fio pattern, read/write scope, block size, depth, workers, size, duration, direct-I/O/cache, preconditioning and threshold contract; retain the 60-minute source coverage.
Preserve/hash logs and SMART/NVMe health before writes; collect complete BW, IOPS, latency, errors, runtime, media/filesystem health, temperature and platform evidence.
Stop on identity mismatch, media/filesystem error, unsafe temperature/power, capacity exhaustion, host instability, hang/reboot or evidence gap; never repair, reformat or retry automatically.
No NVQual/fio, storage write/read, log clearing, repair/reformat, re-provision, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Stable-target-identity-interlocked HGX NVQual Test #18 SSD stress
test_case.purpose: Stress the explicitly disposable owner-designated SSD/volume with the approved Test #18 workload and prove required performance, error-free completion, device/filesystem health and host stability without touching protected storage, hanging or rebooting the system.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #18 or exact fio job and compatible fio version
Signed disposable target manifest: serial/WWN/namespace and full storage-stack identity
Approved pattern, read/write scope, block size, depth, workers, size, duration, direct-I/O/cache, preconditioning and thresholds
Maintenance window, capacity/endurance/thermal limits, BMC/console, abort/isolation and re-provision recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and explicit data-loss approval are signed. Perform read-only stable-identity and full storage-stack checks immediately before launch; inhibit on any protected, mounted production, shared, unknown or changed mapping. Preserve logs and SMART/NVMe baseline. Run only the pinned Test #18/fio job for 60 minutes, collect complete metrics and health, and stop on first anomaly. Do not choose a target, repair, reformat or retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact authorized disposable target completes the approved workload and duration with every signed performance/latency/error/health threshold met, no unintended device or data touched, acceptable endurance/temperature/capacity, intact expected filesystem/platform health, and no hang or reboot.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without stable target proof, explicit data-loss authorization, exact job and signed thresholds. PASS requires complete accepted performance and health evidence for the authorized identity. FAIL on wrong/changed target, any protected-storage exposure, incomplete workload, threshold miss, I/O/media/filesystem error, unsafe thermal/capacity/endurance state, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing inputs are BLOCKED; later repair/retry cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until disposable target identity, data-loss approval, protected-storage exclusions, exact job, thresholds and recovery are signed.
Re-resolve serial/WWN/namespace and the complete storage stack immediately before any write; path-only identity is rejected.
Preserve baseline logs/health and use an isolated maintenance window with console and sufficient capacity/cooling.
Stop without repair, reformat, reset or automatic retry on first mismatch or fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, signed target manifest and explicit data-loss authorization
Stable serial/WWN/namespace/storage-stack map and protected-target exclusion proof captured immediately before launch
Pinned Test #18/fio job/configuration hash and signed performance/health/thermal limits
Complete raw BW/IOPS/latency/error/runtime output and workload accounting
Pre/during/post SMART/NVMe health, media counters, temperature, filesystem/capacity, kernel/BMC/SEL evidence
Abort/isolation/re-provision or clean final state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On target mismatch, I/O/media/filesystem fault, capacity/thermal/endurance limit, host instability or evidence gap, terminate I/O, preserve first-fault data and isolate the target. Do not repair, format or rerun automatically; follow the signed backup/re-provision plan and quarantine if identity or health is uncertain.
